guidance.heading: Choosing a weld-on adapter
guidance.body: Choose by the tube O.D. the weld end must match, then by the thread and gender. A female swivel lets the joint be made up without turning the welded tube. Remove the plating around the weld before welding. Stainless weld-on adapters are listed under Stainless Steel Weld Outlets & Weld-On Adapters.

standards.heading: Threads
standards.body: JIC 37° ends follow SAE J514; NPT ends ASME B1.20.1.

products.title: 316 Stainless Steel Weld-On Tube or Pipe × ORFS Female Swivel Adapter
products.descriptionShort: 316 Stainless Steel Weld-On Tube or Pipe × ORFS Female Swivel Adapter: 18 part numbers, 1/4" to 2", weld end for tube O.D. or pipe.
products.descriptionLong:
The 316 Stainless Steel Weld-On Tube or Pipe × ORFS Female Swivel Adapter is a straight swivel adapter that is welded onto a tube, a metal hose or a manifold to give it a ORFS connection. It is forged 316 stainless steel. Each size comes with the weld end bored for tube O.D. or for pipe; the Sizes & Part Numbers tab says which.

Ends and sealing

  • Weld end: plain bore for a butt weld to tube O.D. or pipe; weld procedure and filler to suit the material.
  • ORFS female swivel end: O-ring face seal against a flat-faced male; SAE J1453.

Sizes

18 part numbers, 1/4" to 2". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab gives both ends for every one.

Pressure rating

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. The finished joint holds what the weld, the tube or hose and the threaded end allow; tell us the working pressure and we will confirm it.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the tube or pipe size and the thread. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.descriptionShort: Steel Weld-On Tube × NPT Male Adapter: 8 part numbers, 1/4" to 2", weld end for tube O.D..
products.descriptionLong:
The Steel Weld-On Tube × NPT Male Adapter is a straight rigid adapter that is welded onto a tube, a metal hose or a manifold to give it a NPT connection. It is forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated (ASTM B633).

Ends and sealing

  • Weld end: plain bore for a butt weld to tube O.D.; weld procedure and filler to suit the material.
  • NPT male end: tapered pipe thread that seals on the thread with sealant; ASME B1.20.1.

Sizes

8 part numbers, 1/4" to 2". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab gives both ends for every one.

Pressure rating

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. The finished joint holds what the weld, the tube or hose and the threaded end allow; tell us the working pressure and we will confirm it.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the tube or pipe size and the thread. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
